summary: Abstain from a new numerical path/ribbon recipe. The inspected closure supports conditional exposed sampling and saved representation geometry, but contains neither independent physical annotations nor independently fixed, separately switchable heading/centerline/width/bend arms. No novel nonduplicating saved-only falsifier of physical correctness was established. Preserve the existing saved counterexample rather than rerun geometry or repeat four calls.

source_base.meaning: Parent-supplied read-only source identity; no Git mutation or fresh remote authentication by S4.

actual_contracts.finding: profileAt pools longitudinal samples per lateral offset. edgePairOf selects one rising/falling pair by score subject to a nominal-width hypothesis; exported l/r/c/w do not retain stationwise physical correspondence. stationContrastAt computes arithmetic RGB-mean inside-minus-outside contrasts and binary validity. Its internal inside/outside support fractions are not exported. A valid flag is not proof of common support across rotated arms, path identity, calibrated confidence or AA.

planHeadingQueries changes phi alone within each group while retaining an exposed fitted-center/fitted-width baseline. Primary and bright controls use different fitted constants. It is not a factorial c/w/h/b design, an independent annotation or a shared-physical-support contrast. Its executed E4009 result must not be repeated as fresh evidence.

classifyFit jointly changes origin using fitted cPx and width using fitted wPx, with PHI fixed. It does not independently switch centerline and width. The public original-evidence helper is fixed-root, plan-only and not admitted for execution; no token/planner/output was consumed.

describePath measures supplied vertices/edge pairs only. Pair association/orientation and width provenance are caller testimony; each supplied segment is a run. countTurns requires an explicit caller definition and predicate. Neither operation supplies physical bend segmentation, path identity or independent calibration.

Both frames and edge/midpoint channels derive from the same fits. The pi/4 definition was explicitly chosen after exposure; width42/50 are hypotheses, not calibrated truths. Missing pairs break runs; fitted polylines do not authenticate one physical ribbon.
